title: Airy Auburn French Gelatin Crepes
description: A delicate French dessert featuring unflavored gelatin and a hint of wine, perfect for a post-workout snack. This dish is nut-free and temper-friendly.
instructions: In a small bowl, bloom the gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, red wine, and water, and heat over low heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the bloomed gelatin, stirring until dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites and salt until stiff peaks form.
Temper the egg mixture into the gelatin mixture, stirring gently.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and pour a small amount of the mixture into the pan.
Tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Repeat the process until all the mixture is used, making about 8-10 crepes.
